scientific_scope.exposure: All GP15 responses, original finite-corner outputs and existing directions already exposed. This is an exploratory mathematical coverage refinement, not validation.
immutable_choices: Original24/55 unique primary bottles and all six inclusive pH-reported-depth layers
Primary record weights, exact original source-decimal REE/pH values, author PAAS/molar masses
Original fixed beta/intercept, atomic numbers and reference means from frozen protocol
Same four shared coherent RSD coordinates and full [-1,1]^4 box
Exactly original nine discrete observed/training pH-offset pairs
No new fit, correction, new distribution, sub-box, exclusion, real-error bound or joint-coefficient propagation
scientific_scope.object_definition: The original decimal tokens in the six bound inputs define exact rational numbers. Published model arithmetic is interpreted over these reals. Legacy binary-float outputs are compared within fixed tolerance; the analysis does not formally verify every IEEE operation or bound real measurement errors.

arithmetic.source_parse: CSV numeric lexemes are Decimal-validated then converted to Fraction. JSON source numeric lexemes are loaded with parse_float=Decimal and converted to Fraction; binary floats are rejected as arithmetic inputs. Z comes from the frozen protocol and is checked against62/64/66/68.
exact_quantities: Normalization denominators and all four mean normalized compositions per original primary layer
Fixed alpha, predicted/observed/reference means and signed errors
All component lower limits, corner errors, MSEs, MSE differences, positivity/ranking decisions
arithmetic.square_roots: Decimal precision50 is used only for displayed square roots/RMSE differences. Matching irrationals to old float-valued decimal results instead uses exact rational sqrt enclosures from integer isqrt, with grid10^-60 and mathematically verified lower^2<=MSE<=upper^2. The full candidate enclosure must lie within old_value +/-1e-10. Exact MSE signs determine ranking; displayed rounded values never determine certificates.
arithmetic.matching_tolerance: Fixed absolute1e-10 pH for each observed/model/reference primary mean/error, each unshifted corner mean, every shifted layer error, all stored bias/MAE/RMSE and deltaRMSE. No tolerance tuning.
arithmetic.display: CSV sqrt/RMSE display50 significant digits; concise SI table differences six decimals. These are labeled approximations rather than directed-rounded RMSE endpoint bounds. Exact rational MSE bounds/differences are retained.

algorithm: Read and verify the exact six role/path/SHA bindings and root frozen plan/code SHA before source parsing; require Python3.12 and no pre-existing output directory.
Confirm original protocol frozen identities, same four elements/Z/coefficients/edges, primary inclusive pH depth and record weights, four RSD scales and exact9offset pair lists.

Reconstruct12 primary mean compositions/predictions/errors from original per-bottle concentration/pH decimal tokens and constants, using exact original layer membership lists. Check no duplicate memberships, exact station counts, source sample identities and unique24/55 support. Check expected C column signs(+,+,-,-).

Compare60 primary values;576 unshifted corner-layer mean values;5472 shifted corner layer-errors/aggregate quantities across original16corners x9pairs x2legs. All6108 matching records must be produced. Original baseline does not receive REE perturbation.

If any fixed-tolerance comparison fails, release only full matching diagnostics, failure.json and source/output manifests; return nonzero. Do not calculate/release envelope coefficients, bounds, ranking or SI outputs from that run.

Only after all consistency matches pass, list12 layers of C and all18x6 component lower limits. The convex norm maximum is the exact maximum over16vertices for each fixed offset pair, because reference norm is constant in u.

If all six exact component lower limits are strictly positive, certify the minimum at(-1,-1,+1,+1) and check its MSE equals the finite-corner minimum; opposite corner must attain maximum. Otherwise leave minimum/lower MSE/lower difference fields empty/null and mark unproved_by_selected_criterion. No alternate search or proof is attempted.

Use exact MSE upper difference<0 to certify model_better_throughout_box. Use a proved exact MSE lower difference>0 to certify reference_better_throughout_box. Otherwise report strict_uniform_ordering_not_certified. Preserve all18pair rows without selecting favorable cases.

Write exact-fraction CSV/JSON values plus50-digit display values and concise SI explanation to a new directory only. Source manifest records inputs/code/plan and author self-check status; output manifest hashes every other output, explicitly omitting its own recursive hash.

stop_rules.identity_or_structure_failure: Any role/path/SHA/model/support/count/sign/coverage failure raises and stops with no scientific output directory. Root preserves the error receipt.
stop_rules.legacy_numeric_match_failure: Any of6108 matches failing the fixed tolerance makes the entire envelope unavailable. Complete diagnostics and failure/source/output manifests may be written to the new output directory; envelope results are not released. Exit2. No tolerances or parameters are changed.
stop_rules.positive_error_condition_failure: This is a pair-specific sufficient-condition failure, not a failed run. That pair lower/MSE-min fields remain blank/null and marked unproved; convex-maximum output remains supported. This is not evidence that uniform ordering failed.
stop_rules.zero_or_noncertified_ranking_margin: No strict uniform ranking is certified where the exact required difference is zero or the needed minimum proof is unavailable. No near-zero tolerance is used to manufacture a sign.
stop_rules.source_changed_before_write: All source/script/plan SHAs are rechecked immediately before first output write. A mismatch stops; existing/partial outputs are never overwritten.
stop_rules.no_chasing: No revised box, subset, threshold, sign criterion, optimizer, coefficient, eligibility or scenario deletion within this plan.

output_definitions.layer_coefficients.csv: 12 primary rows; exact normalized mean R, alpha, three means, base error, four C coefficients and source row/sample membership locators. C is pH error change per unit u_j.
output_definitions.pair_residual_lower_bounds.csv: 108 rows(18pairs x6layers), exact component lower limits, exact positivity booleans and complete-pair criterion.
output_definitions.pair_envelope.csv: 18rows with exact minimum(if proved)/maximum model MSE, reference MSE, MSE differences, exact positive margin, extrema vertex IDs, displayed RMSE differences and strict-ranking certificate. Unproved lower fields empty.
output_definitions.ranking_certificates.json: All18pair exact-fraction certificate objects, all component lower limits, explicit unproved/null minima, chosen corner evidence and statement that independent numerical validation is pending.
output_definitions.vertex_matching.csv: All6108 scalar/interval matching comparisons with original nested-source locators, fixed exact tolerance, candidate exact enclosure, original decimal number, worst absolute-error bound and pass/fail.
output_definitions.continuous_box_supplement.md: Concise mathematical proof,18-pair six-decimal display table, exact/discrete domain and uncertainty limits; author checks explicitly not independent validation.
output_definitions.failure.json: Only on numeric matching failure: unavailable status, failing comparison IDs and explicit no envelope release.
